title: Merge Feature Branch to Main, Build Verification, and Production Deployment Preparation
objective: Merge feature/founder-approved-product-system into main, verify clean git tree, execute production build verification, and prepare deployment checklist for live Cloudflare Pages / Vercel release.
in_scope: Safely checkout main and merge feature/founder-approved-product-system with zero merge conflicts
Run full production build (npm run build) generating dist/server.cjs and dist/index.html
Run automated pre-flight release gate (npm run verify:preflight) on main branch
Generate production deployment checklist and release notes for Founder live rollout
out_of_scope: Directly pushing to remote GitHub repository without Founder explicit release consent
Triggering live cloud CI/CD webhook deployments without Founder confirmation
Modifying live production database credentials or third-party secret tokens
acceptance_criteria: main branch contains all 5 approved work packages with unbroken commit lineage
npm run build completes with zero errors and zero TypeScript warnings
npm run verify:preflight passes 6/6 release gates with 100% green status on main
Complete release manifest and smoke testing protocol delivered to Founder
risks: Git merge conflicts if uncommitted local files conflict. Mitigation: Stash or preserve untracked scratch notes before merging.
